exposure: degree of surgical completion of endometriosis
cohort: The study included 2781 deliveries at Hirosaki University Hospital, divided into a case group with a history of endometriosis (n=133) and a control group without endometriosis (n=2648).
finding: A history of endometriosis is an independent risk factor for placenta previa, and complete surgical treatment for stage III-IV endometriosis before pregnancy significantly lowers the incidence of placenta previa.
